_doc: Admin-issued reset links. check -> reset -> a login-shaped answer. Using a link deletes EVERY session of the user and clears a forced password change. One 400 token_invalid for an unknown, expired, used or disabled-user token. Plan 3 adds the two-factor branch: a user with MFA gets mfa_required instead of a session.

body.message: This link is not valid any more. Ask for a new one.
